hooks.command: input=$(/bin/cat); if printf '%s' "$input" | /usr/bin/grep -Eq '"stop_hook_active"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*true'; then exit 0; fi; if [ -z "$(/usr/bin/git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all)" ]; then exit 0; fi; if pnpm run verify:changed -- --base origin/main --worktree; then exit 0; fi; printf '%s\n' '{"decision":"block","reason":"verify:changed failed; fix the reported checks before stopping."}' >&2; exit 2
